pack_version_submitted_consistency_check.name: pack_version_submitted_consistency_check
pack_version_submitted_consistency_check.value: ("pack_version"."submitted_at" IS NULL) OR ("pack_version"."submitted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "pack_version"."submitted_role" IS NOT NULL AND "pack_version"."configuration_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pack_version"."frozen_configuration" IS NOT NULL AND "pack_version"."lane_mapping_version" IS NOT NULL AND "pack_version"."lane_mapping" IS NOT NULL AND "pack_version"."manifest_hash" IS NOT NULL)

artifact_slot_artifact_check.name: artifact_slot_artifact_check
artifact_slot_artifact_check.value: ("artifact_slot"."state" = 'attached' AND "artifact_slot"."artifact_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("artifact_slot"."state" <> 'attached' AND "artifact_slot"."artifact_id" IS NULL)

disposition_event_reason_check.name: disposition_event_reason_check
disposition_event_reason_check.value: "disposition_event"."kind" NOT IN ('waived', 'not_applicable') OR "disposition_event"."reason" IS NOT NULL

operator_job_state_check.name: operator_job_state_check
operator_job_state_check.value: ("operator_job_run"."status" = 'running' AND "operator_job_run"."finished_at" IS NULL AND "operator_job_run"."error_stage" IS NULL AND "operator_job_run"."error_code" IS NULL) OR ("operator_job_run"."status" = 'completed' AND "operator_job_run"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "operator_job_run"."breach_count" IS NOT NULL AND "operator_job_run"."error_stage" IS NULL AND "operator_job_run"."error_code" IS NULL) OR ("operator_job_run"."status" = 'failed' AND "operator_job_run"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "operator_job_run"."error_stage" IS NOT NULL AND "operator_job_run"."error_code" IS NOT NULL AND "operator_job_run"."error_stage" IN ('query', 'render', 'enqueue') AND "operator_job_run"."error_code" IN ('query_failed', 'render_failed', 'enqueue_failed', 'internal_error'))

risk_proposal_status_consistency_check.name: risk_proposal_status_consistency_check
risk_proposal_status_consistency_check.value: ("risk_proposal"."status" = 'proposed' AND "risk_proposal"."tier" IS NOT NULL AND "risk_proposal"."rubric_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "risk_proposal"."unavailable_reason" IS NULL) OR ("risk_proposal"."status" = 'unavailable' AND "risk_proposal"."tier" IS NULL AND "risk_proposal"."unavailable_reason" IS NOT NULL)
